title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
before: o1 had shown RL-trained reasoning worked, with no published method.
problem: Nobody outside OpenAI knew whether it needed vast supervised reasoning data or some undisclosed trick.
breakthrough: Reasoning emerged from reinforcement learning alone, with no supervised cold start, using GRPO on a V3 base. Weights released under MIT.
why: It replicated the reasoning paradigm openly and cheaply, and became the first frontier LLM result peer-reviewed in Nature.
next: Open reasoning models across Qwen, Kimi and GLM, and distilled reasoning into small models.
inherits: Reasoning as something you can train yourself, with a published recipe.
